skill.summary: MANDATORY security foundation for OpenClaw. Consolidate scattered API keys and credentials into a secure .env file with proper permissions. Includes GPG encryption for high-value secrets, credential rotation tracking, deep scanning, and backup hardening. Use when setting up OpenClaw, migrating credentials, auditing security, or enforcing the .env standard. This is not optional — centralized credential management is a core requirement for secure OpenClaw deployments.

latestVersion.changelog: GPG encryption for high-value secrets, deep scanning for hardcoded credentials, rotation tracking with risk-based schedules, backup hardening, and comprehensive security validation
